entry.author: Whitireia and WelTec
entry.summary:
Motion graphics transforms static design into dynamic visual storytelling. In this project, ākonga created an engaging promotional video for a hypothetical bubble tea café, using animated typography and abstract shapes to express the brand’s energy and appeal. Guided by motion design principles – such as timing, squash & stretch, ease, arcs, emphasis, contrast, scale, and rhythm – they crafted vibrant visuals designed to resonate with the intended target audience.

Jasmine Hay, Seungbeom Son, Sophia Jones, Toby Kilford, Torridon Stallworthy, Meruert Omarkhanova, Grace Huang, Awhina Anderson, Junior Fetoai, Brant Foesther, Jayden Yap, Sam Maddocks, Shalom Pikari, Jasper Theodorou, Lia Vaamailalo 

Bachelor of Creativity Level 5 & 6: Image Making 2, Applied Media 3 

Bubble Tea: Motion Graphics, (2025)
